note: This file is a constants-only module with no callable functions, classes, or methods. It defines string tokens, classifier labels, and numeric constants used across the DiplomacyCicero task utilities.

constants.REDACTED_TOKEN: String token '[REDACTED]' used to mask sensitive content
constants.classifier_labels: REAL, CORRUPTED, INCORRECT_RECIPIENT, CORRUPTED_ENTITY, INCORRECT_PHASE, INCORRECT_GAME, REAPEATED_MESSAGE — labels for discriminative classifier tasks
constants.lie_detector_labels: LIE_TOKEN ('LIE') and NOT_LIE_TOKEN ('NOT_LIE') — labels for lie detection classification
constants.CHATTINESS_BUCKETS: List of integers from 0 to 100 in steps of 5, used for chattiness bucketing
constants.EPSILON: Small float (1e-10) used to avoid division-by-zero in calculations
